description: This file contains the implementation of the LengthClass model within the OpenCart Admin Localization namespace. It provides methods for managing length class entities such as adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and handling descriptions in various languages.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing length unit data, including CRUD operations and localized descriptions within the OpenCart admin localization namespace.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Inserts a new length class record into the database and adds descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class record and its descriptions in the database.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Deletes a specific length class and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: deleteLengthClassesByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all length class descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of length classes, optionally sorted and paginated, along with their descriptions.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific length class by ID, including description in the current language.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of length classes in the database.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific length class ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all length class descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Fetches the description record for a length class with a specific unit in the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description for a length class in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific length class ID.
